|-- Page composition and service lifetimes
|   |-- MappingPocPage({ services }: { services: MappingServices })
|   |   `-- Provides MappingServicesContext to MappingWorkspacePage.
|   |-- useMappingServices(): diagrams, canvasHistory, workspaceStorage
|   |   `-- Injected service lifetimes are unspecified here.
|   |-- The page creates and disposes its workspace and edit coordinator.
|   |-- new CanvasWorkspace(diagramService, canvasHistory)
|   `-- Locally created storage is flushed and disposed on cleanup.
|-- CanvasWorkspace manages draft sessions and subscriptions
|   |-- CanvasDraft extends DraftMetadata { session: CanvasSession }
|   |-- setDrafts(value)
|   |   |-- Seeds create sessions; replacement or removal disposes old sessions.
|   |   `-- controllers: Map<string, MappingDocumentController>
|   |-- Session commits trigger persistence notifications.
|   |-- copyDocument(input)
|   |   |-- Checks availability, name, busy state and optional expectedVersion.
|   |   `-- controller.forkHistory(canvas)
|   `-- Copies reset selection, controls and conversation pending flags.
|-- CanvasSession publishes controller state through readable stores
|   |-- new MappingDocumentController(input.document, input.canvas, ...)
|   |-- The controller manages domain state; session stores publish references.
|   |-- shape: readable(store) => { getState, getInitialState, subscribe }
|   |-- document; presentation; selection; controls; geometry; status
|   |-- One subscription publishes changes synchronously.
|   |-- statusOf(snapshot)
|   |   `-- Dirty status needs scene, edges and name compared with saved baselines.
|   `-- dispose() unsubscribes and clears commit listeners.
|-- Document and presentation contracts
|   |-- MappingGridDocument: scene, edges, sections, jumps?
|   |   `-- The scene supplies grid geometry and diagram content references.
|   |-- MappingCanvasState: selection, diagramViews?, display, controls
|   |-- SelectionState.items: readonly SelectionItem[]
|   |   |-- Membership and insertion order are separate from focus and panels.
|   |   `-- selectionCommand(state, command)
|   |-- The reducer deduplicates regions and excludes whole/region overlap.
|   |-- MappingControls: activeBoxId, selectionFocusId, activeThreadId, surfaces
|   `-- Per-selection surfaces retain prompt, action and presentation settings.
|-- canvasDisplayNodes(document, canvas, version, cell, endpointBounds?)
|   |-- Builds a read-only registry; geometry has no second writable copy.
|   |-- shape: CanvasDisplayNode = grid variant | floating variant
|   |-- Grid nodes use cell bounds; floating nodes use pixel geometry.
|   |-- gridNodeId(id); floatingNodeId(id)
|   |-- Grid projection needs scene contents and per-instance diagramViews.
|   `-- drawEdge(edge, document.scene, canvas.diagramViews, cell, endpointBounds)
|-- SourcePaneViewState manages live scroll and camera state
|   |-- entries; cameras; captures; timers; listeners
|   |-- bind(documentId, paneId, sourceFile, fallback?, sourceId?)
|   |   `-- A binding token prevents stale viewers from writing scroll state.
|   |-- captureDisplay(documentId, display); captureCamera(documentId, fallback?)
|   |-- Captures sample live state when saving or copying.
|   `-- flush(); prune(documentId, display); dispose()
|-- Rendering, editing and search
|   |-- render: DraggableDiagramCanvas > MappingPocSelectionCanvas
|   |   `-- The page supplies the session and records camera changes in viewState.
|   |-- Previously visited document views remain mounted and can be hidden.
|   |-- DiagramEditComposer: coordinator={diagramEdits}
|   |-- DiagramSearchService.sync(searchDocuments)
|   |   `-- Search needs saved revisions, visible drafts and the active proposal.
|   |-- revealSearchResult(result)
|   |   `-- Checks content revision and hash before focusing a result.
|   `-- ChangeSessionPreview and MappingDiagramExplorer receive page callbacks.
|-- Workspace persistence and navigation
|   |-- new WorkspacePersistence(workspace, storage.records, projectId, viewState)
|   |-- The page disposes adapters and pauses synchronization while busy.
|   |-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot
|   |   `-- Captures histories, documents, views, cameras, metadata and transfers.
|   |-- restore(workspace); workspaceAction(action, imported?)
|   `-- Restore validates project identity and prunes unavailable saved canvases.
`-- Project operations and agent integration
    |-- saveMappingProjectDiagram({ history, scene, edges, expectedRevisionId, ... })
    |-- Save acknowledgements update the captured baseline.
    |-- openAccepted(session, documentId)
    |   `-- Preserves newer local edits when they differ from the reviewed baseline.
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge(descriptor, handleAgentCommand, workspace)
    `-- The page dispatches commands and coordinates whole-workspace transfers.
